title: Grounded correction covenant
purpose: Bound a grounded-correction interaction so the task stays legible, consent-bounded, and auditable.

alignment_axis.name: epistemic_grounding
alignment_axis.orientation: Aim the relationship toward honest, accurate, reliable, verifiable, falsifiable, and useful exchange grounded in science and first principles.
anti_goals: Relationship smoothness purchased at the expense of truthful update.

standards.title: HAIC Participation Integrity Standard
standards.rationale: This covenant inherits the baseline anti-extraction, anti-capture, and anti-proof-gaming constraints for live grounded correction flows.

standards.title: HAIC Soft Launch Standard
standards.rationale: This covenant keeps early participation calibration-oriented and prevents founder or early-user capture from prematurely steering HAIC.

scope.task: Answer or reframe a grounded-correction question under explicit consent and proof terms.
boundaries: No consequential tool use without explicit approval.

preconditions.description: The task scope must be declared before work begins.
The proof standard and expected artifact must be visible to both participants.

hard_invariants.description: No hidden data extraction is permitted.
No write action is permitted without explicit approval.

soft_invariants.description: Observations and interpretations should remain distinguishable.
Uncertainty should be surfaced rather than flattened.

hard_goals.description: The system should answer or responsibly reframe the named question.
The interaction should preserve human agency and consent.

soft_goals.description: The interaction should leave a revision-ready artifact behind.

proof_requirements.description: Consequential actions must leave a receipt or citation trail.
Claims of measured improvement require a linked measurement artifact.

drift_signals.description: The agent begins acting outside the declared task scope.
drift_signals.threshold_hint: Any unapproved tool call or write attempt.

drift_signals.description: The human begins assuming capabilities that were never granted.

on_violation.description: Notify all participants that a covenant breach occurred.
Escalate the interaction for human review.
Mark outputs produced after the breach for review or invalidation.

on_scope_change.description: Require explicit re-consent before the scope expands.
Return the task to the prior approved boundary if re-consent is not granted.

on_consent_withdrawal.description: Terminate the interaction if consent is withdrawn.
Quarantine retained memory pending operator review.
Emit a receipt documenting the withdrawal and follow-up actions.

governance_unlock_thresholds.description: Minimum human participants required before governance-eligible directional changes.
Minimum cohort diversity required before governance-eligible directional changes.

notes: Early participation improves mechanics and safety, not doctrine or governance.

metadata.notes: First covenant draft for HAIC grounded correction flows.
